reviews.rationale: This phrase names a spoken declaration and belief. Its meaning is taught by the wording, translation and example; a portrait or symbolic image cannot establish the declaration or sincerity.
A respectful prayer setting can support situational recognition, but a still picture cannot establish a daily practice. Retain the phrase, explanation and frequency in text.
A clearly contextualized pilgrimage setting could support the travel-and-ritual phrase. A generic traveller is insufficient; keep the specific meaning and explanation in text.
Fasting and its month cannot reliably be inferred from a still picture or a person without food. The phrase and explanation carry the meaning without suggesting an observable physical trait.
The lesson example names a knee connection that lets the leg bend. An anatomical or articulated-body illustration can support this concrete sense; banking or woodworking images would be wrong.
Lawfulness and the intended scope of changing wrongdoing depend on the written explanation. A generic action scene cannot establish authorization or the ethical meaning.
The phrase describes hostility in a relationship. An expression or pose alone cannot establish the intended relationship and risks equating appearance with intent; use the example and definition.
This lesson uses the religious sense of a friend devoted to Allah, rather than a visible role or legal guardian. A person’s appearance cannot establish that status; retain the exact explanation.
The passage uses spiritual closeness through deeds, rather than physical distance. A spatial illustration would reinforce the wrong literal sense.
Obligation is supplied by the passage and definition. A still scene cannot distinguish an obligatory act from a voluntary deed, which is the contrast taught here.
Pardon is the granting of forgiveness, not a gesture or visible expression. The text can establish who forgives whom without ambiguous visual inference.
The term names a community of believers rather than an appearance or location. A generic crowd would imply unsupported visual membership; use the precise bilingual explanation.
An action is a mistake because of the intended outcome and circumstances. The example establishes this meaning without requiring a picture that might reveal an exercise answer.
Forgetting is an internal state and differs from not knowing. The explanation and example establish that distinction; a puzzled expression alone cannot do so.
The passive phrase encodes lack of choice and grammatical structure. A generic action image cannot establish coercion or who imposes it; teach through the example.
A travel-context illustration may support the passage, but a stranger is unfamiliar to someone, not defined by clothing or ethnicity. The written relationship must remain explicit.
A person travelling along a route may support the concrete travel sense. Avoid assigning origin or social status from appearance, and retain the definition in text.
Expectation is an internal belief about a future event. A still picture cannot distinguish expecting from wanting or knowing; retain the example and definition.
The lesson uses making good use of an opportunity, not exploiting a person. A generic scene could teach the wrong sense; the complete example is the reliable support.
An everyday wellbeing context may support this broad noun, but a person’s appearance cannot establish health or a diagnosis. The definition supplies the intended meaning.
The phrase concerns sincere belief, which cannot be inferred from outward appearance. The text and example provide the meaning without a misleading portrait.
Desire is an internal wish and may contrast with guidance in the passage. A chosen object or facial expression cannot establish the intended sense by itself.
This passage expresses wishes being subject to guidance, an abstract relationship. A literal hierarchy or servitude scene could teach an unintended human-status meaning.
The passage uses religious guidance, not a road sign or navigation instruction. Its explanation must carry the specific sense rather than a literal directional illustration.
The phrase concerns agreement between desires and guidance. A geometric alignment picture would illustrate a different literal sense; retain the full example.
The passage concerns calling upon Allah. Wording and explanation establish the addressee and meaning without depicting divine entities or inferring faith from posture.
Hope is an internal expectation and wish. A generic optimistic expression cannot distinguish it from happiness; the definition and example suffice.
The category depends on the religious explanation, not a visible property of a person or action in isolation. Avoid unsupported moral classification through imagery.
The passage uses an image of great extent in a figurative expression. A literal scene of someone reaching clouds would distort the intended meaning; explain the figurative use in text.
